text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Tanishq new store additions target 35 to 40 for FY26",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.",
      "outcome": "No specific total Tanishq store addition count provided in later reported call summaries.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2025 / Feb 2026 reported data"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Eyecare growth outlook expected to close FY26 between 13% to 14%",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.",
      "outcome": "Feb 2026 call reports domestic growth of 17.5% and omnichannel growth of 11%, but full-year consolidated Eyecare growth is not specified.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Feb 2026 call reported data"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Eyewear volume growth estimated around 8% to 10%",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "So from a volume growth standpoint, it is more or less within our zone. This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth.",
      "outcome": "Reported volume growth reached close to 8%.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Feb 2026 call reported data"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Watches business margins to revert to 15%-16% over 1 to 2 years",
      "made_in": "Nov 2025",
      "quote": "mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.",
      "outcome": "Target timeframe of 1 to 2 years has not yet elapsed.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2025 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Jewellery business margin center of gravity around 11% for full year",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.",
      "outcome": "Titan Jewellery normalized margin achieved 11.1% (customs adjusted) and 11.7% (MTM/customs adjusted) in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Nov 2026 call reported data"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Anchor margin target at around 11% for FY27",
      "made_in": "Nov 2026",
      "quote": "I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%.",
      "outcome": "Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27) consolidated operating margin reached 14.0%. Titan Jewellery normalized margin reported at 11.1%.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026 / Nov 2026 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "CaratLane EBIT margin to inch towards double-digits over next couple of years",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin... they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile.",
      "outcome": "CaratLane EBIT margin was 9.6% in Q1 FY27 and dropped to 6.5% in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Aug 2026 and Nov 2026 calls reported data"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Target 15% to 20% jewellery growth over 3 to 5 year horizon",
      "made_in": "Jun 2026",
      "quote": "This is the medium to three to five-year horizon if you want to look at. This is the growth rate we are expecting.",
      "outcome": "Multi-year horizon is ongoing; Q2 FY27 YoY revenue growth was 10.0%.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 3,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 0,
    "summary": "Management consistently achieves stated margin targets around 11% for Jewellery and delivers on volume goals while setting realistic multi-year growth targets."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Management anchored Jewellery margin at 11%, aligned with reported normalized margins of 11.1% and 11.7% in Q2 FY27.",
    "Reported Eyewear volume growth of close to 8% matched guidance of 8% to 10% volume growth.",
    "CaratLane EBIT margin narrative emphasized inching towards double digits, but actual margin dropped to 6.5% in Q2 FY27."
  ]
}
